instruction: Using GitKraken, initialize a repo at ~/Documents/gk_stash; create note.txt with content "one" and commit it; modify note.txt by adding a new line "change", then create a stash named "save-wip".

verification.condition: Check that git -C ~/Documents/gk_stash stash list contains an entry with the message "save-wip".
verification.expected_result: One stash entry labeled "save-wip" exists in the repository at ~/Documents/gk_stash.
